steps.title: Project Initialization
steps.description: Initialize Admin Panel Android application project and meta configurations.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings
steps.description: Set up Gradle compile/target SDK versions and build configurations for Java 17 and Gradle 8.5 compatibility.

steps.title: Establish Android Manifest
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml defining package structure, activity filters, permissions, and app themes.

steps.title: Define Color Palette
steps.description: Declare custom dark, neutral, and accent colors for a clean visual material administrative theme.

steps.title: Define UI String Assets
steps.description: Define localized and static text strings used in the application dashboards.

steps.title: Create Material Card Drawable Background
steps.description: Design shadow-effect background layers for metrics, tables, and settings card wrappers.

steps.title: Create Accent Action Buttons
steps.description: Build custom state drawables for interactive navigation buttons and operations.

steps.title: Construct Main User Interface
steps.description: Draft complete layout combining Admin Panel Dashboard, User Controller, Notification Hub, and System Settings panels.

steps.title: Establish User Representation Entity
steps.description: Create standard User model class mapping users with names, roles, and status fields.

steps.title: Code Main Activity Logic
steps.description: Write comprehensive application controller handling tab navigation, mock users list management, custom broadcasts, stats calculation, and localized preference storage.

steps.title: Verify Local Compilation Compatibility
steps.description: Confirm Java 8 language standard compliance, strict typecasting, and explicit callback handles.

steps.title: Building Admin Panel
steps.description: Execute gradle assembleDebug to build the final production administrative control suite application.
